note: The City of Memphis government guide states that the mayor serves a four-year term and gives the next mayoral election as 2027. The regular mayoral cycle is therefore 2011, 2015, 2019, 2023 and 2027. The 2009 special election winner served the remainder of the term that ran to the 2011 election, so no mayoral election fell in 2010. The Election Commission archive has no 2010 page, so this rests on the term cycle.

The City of Memphis government guide gives a four-year mayoral term and places a regular mayoral election in 2011 (cycle 2011, 2015, 2019, 2023, 2027). Secondary sources give October 6, 2011 as the date; they are not used for results. No official 2011 results document was found. Tried in this pass: (1) the Shelby County Election Commission past-elections index and the 2010 and 2011 year pages (no 2011 link; year pages return HTTP 404); (2) the WordPress media library API of electionsshelbytn.gov, searched for 2011, Memphis, mayor, SOVC, minutes, results and 10.6; its earliest minutes are from 2014 and its earliest statements of votes cast are from March 2012, and the only Memphis runoff file (SOVC-Memphis-Run-off-11-3_RN767.pdf) is the November 19, 2015 runoff; (3) the Internet Archive copy of the former site shelbyvote.com (snapshot 2011-11-06 of https://www.shelbyvote.com/ and its Election Reports page, nid=83), which only links to an external results site, shelbyelections.com, and to a report list (DocumentView.aspx?DID=45) that did not load; (4) the Wayback CDX index for shelbyelections.com, which holds only a February 2011 home page and no results files, and for shelbyvote.com 2011-2013, which lists no 2011 results document. The Wayback Machine timed out on most other fetches (document center pages for FID=34). The web search budget was used up, so council minutes and state sources were not searched. The year stays unresolved.

The official statement of votes cast for the November general election was searched. It contains mayoral contests only for other Shelby County towns, none for Memphis.
